title: M3 stable GitHub Pages publication
purpose: Make the canonical Learn-it Next Pages publisher preserve the exact promoted learner root and the exact promoted M3 authoring surface under /authoring/, replacing the temporary human-gate publication dependency without changing product semantics.
invariants: The learner root is rebuilt only from learnerPromotedHead and must remain exactly 366412 bytes with the frozen SHA-256.
The stable /authoring/ subtree is built only from m3PromotedMain.
All nine M3 Authoring Foundation product blobs must be byte-identical to frozenAuthoringHead before deployment.
All six M3 Pages packaging blobs must be byte-identical to frozenPagesHead before deployment.
Frozen M3 product/browser tests and canonical Atlas validators must pass before deployment.
The authoring bundle must be deterministic across two builds.
Live post-deploy smoke must prove the learner root exact digest/bytes and the /authoring/ index plus pages-evidence identity.
No backend, account, synchronization, remote authoring-data transfer, learner semantic, Gate3, Gate4 or M4+ capability is introduced.
No additional human UX gate is required because the deployed M3 sources are byte-identical to the already human-approved candidate.
requiredEvidence: Frozen nine-file Authoring Foundation byte identity PASS.
Frozen six-file Pages packaging byte identity PASS.
M3 authoring and browser packaging regressions PASS.
Learner artifact exact bytes and SHA-256 PASS.
Live learner and /authoring/ post-deploy smoke PASS.
adversarialTests: Any frozen M3 authoring or Pages blob differs by one byte.
Learner artifact differs by one byte or digest.
Stable publisher omits /authoring/ or overwrites learner root semantics.
Live Pages serves stale learner or authoring content after deployment.
Any changed path outside the exact two-file allowlist.
nonGoals: Changing the M3.0 editor, validators, schema or learner runtime.
Backend, accounts, sync, remote publishing, runtime AI, Gate3, Gate4 or M4+.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope gate the operational PR.
Runtime workflow re-verifies exact pinned source identities and frozen product tests before publication.
Live post-deploy smoke verifies the published learner and authoring surfaces.
rollback: Revert this two-file operational change and re-run the prior human-gate deployment harness. Product sources and promoted artifacts remain unchanged.
